items.html: And the essence of the matter — how they were seven and became eleven — is that four posteriors were broken off from Hochma and Bina and from YESHSUT [Israel Saba ve Tvuna], and they were joined above together with these seven kings, and they became eleven. And do not wonder how shells came from Hochma and Bina and so forth, for this is from the aspect of that which clothes in ZON below in order to be Mochin for them, and in that respect it is regarded as ZON itself.
